music: Sparse ambient Southeast Asian folk, instrumental: a soft low khaen (Lao bamboo mouth organ) drone with distant, unhurried phin lute phrases and long silences between them, and a faint high bowed fiddle tone now and then. Calm, curious and a little uneasy, slow tempo, no drums, a steady quiet level from start to end, natural room reverb.

Dark ambient drone, instrumental: a very low sustained reed drone and soft bowed strings holding a dissonant interval, an occasional deep wooden knock and a faint metallic shimmer, close and uneasy. No melody, no drums, very slow, a steady quiet level from start to end.

Cinematic dark ambient tension, instrumental: low bowed cello and viola tremolo over a deep reed drone, swelling steadily in intensity for fifteen seconds with no percussion and no sudden hits, then thinning back to a low held drone at the end.

Tender cinematic Southeast Asian score, instrumental: a soft khaen (Lao bamboo mouth organ) with warm low bowed strings, slow and open, gentle phrases that never quite resolve, quiet relief and uncertainty. Starts very soft, grows a little warmer through the middle, then thins to a single held khaen note at the end, natural room reverb.

Quiet questioning ambience, instrumental: a soft low plucked Thai phin lute note repeated slowly over a hushed bowed drone, sparse and a little uneasy, no drums, settling into near stillness by the end.

Gentle warm Thai folk, instrumental: a soft Thai phin lute playing an unhurried calm melody in a warm middle register over a quiet khaen drone, kind and a little wistful, slow tempo, sparse with space, steady and soft throughout, ending on a quiet open note.

Reflective night-time cinematic piano, instrumental: soft felt piano and warm electric piano chords over a low synth pad, slow, lonely and hushed, with a faint distant khaen phrase like a memory, fading into a held unresolved chord at the end.
remakes: Dark ambient, instrumental: a soft sustained reed tone and bowed violas holding a dissonant interval in the middle register, slowly shifting, with an occasional faint ring of a struck metal bowl, close and uneasy. Nothing deep: no bass, no sub-bass, no low drone, no drums, no melody. Very slow, a steady quiet level from start to end.
